summary_1line: Bhishma recounts teachings on household offerings, the spiritual merits of flowers, incense, and lamps, and proper ritual gifts to deities and beings.

image_candidates.scene_text: Manu and the golden-complexioned ascetic Suvarna sit together on the shining golden slopes of Mount Meru discussing sacred rites.
A devotee offers a glowing ghee lamp before the deities in a dark shrine, the flame rising upward and illuminating the idols.
Vali, king of the Asuras, respectfully receives the sage Sukra with water and a seat in his royal hall before asking about sacred offerings.
